color.note: Two themes with equal rank. Dark mode is not an inversion: session tiles stay muted, the accent lightens, no pure black. Every text pair on the Contrast table in the README passes WCAG AA.

tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, inputs, sheets. One step above surface-base.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Chips, inactive segments, quiet fills inside a raised surface.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, progress tracks. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines (dashed add-tiles, unchecked boxes, outlined buttons). At least 3:1 against the surface it sits on.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body and headings on surface-base and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Captions, counts, helper text on surface-base or surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill and active state: olive. Text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on accent.

tokens.name: accent-warm
tokens.usage: Highlights: active chip, badge, selected row, morning identity.

tokens.name: on-accent-warm
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on accent-warm.

tokens.name: icon-warm
tokens.usage: Heart and flame glyphs on surface-raised. Icons only, never body text.

tokens.name: tile-morning
tokens.usage: Morning azkar tile and reader background.

tokens.name: on-tile-morning
tokens.usage: Content on tile-morning.

tokens.name: tile-evening
tokens.usage: Evening azkar tile and reader background.

tokens.name: on-tile-evening
tokens.usage: Content on tile-evening.

tokens.name: tile-sleep
tokens.usage: Sleep azkar tile and reader background.

tokens.name: on-tile-sleep
tokens.usage: Content on tile-sleep.

tokens.name: tile-done
tokens.usage: Completed states: finished dhikr counter, session-complete screen, awrad done tile.

tokens.name: on-tile-done
tokens.usage: Content on tile-done.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Active item fill in the floating navigation bar.

tokens.name: on-nav-active
tokens.usage: Icon and label on the active navigation item.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive text and the fill of destructive buttons.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard and switch-control focus outline, offset 2px.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Tap counter on the full-screen awrad counter.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Dhikr counter numeral, big streak number.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Tile titles, section titles, large button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Paragraphs: fadl and explanation text. Arabic needs 1.75 leading.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, list-row titles, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counts, helper text, metadata. Never for anything the user must read to act.

spacing.note: 4-point scale. Every padding, gap and margin is a token. Nothing between steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small controls; inner padding of compact elements.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles and list rows; padding inside small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding inside cards and sheets; gap between sections of related content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter (left and right edge of every screen).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding inside large tiles; bottom safe margin above floating navigation.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between unrelated groups.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large vertical rhythm on onboarding screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above a screen title block on onboarding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Top inset below the status bar on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Reserved for tablet gutters.

radius.note: 4-point scale plus full. Buttons are always pills.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress bars, thin indicators.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small badges, focus outline radius.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon buttons with a square silhouette, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inner panels inside a card (text well in a bottom sheet).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: List rows, inputs, option rows, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Session tiles, bottom-sheet top corners, hero tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, segmented control, switch track and circular icon button.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline glyph next to 12px captions.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Glyph inside chips and small buttons.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Default icon size. Stroke 2px.

tokens.name: size-icon-xl
tokens.usage: Tile icons.

tokens.name: size-icon-2xl
tokens.usage: Empty-state glyphs.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Visual height of chips and segment items. The hit area still extends to 48px.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, secondary buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and list-row actions.

tokens.name: size-control-xl
tokens.usage: Floating navigation bar, large list rows.

tokens.name: size-touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum interactive target in any direction.

tokens.name: size-gutter
tokens.usage: Screen left and right padding. Same value as space-5.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Standard dhikr row height.

tokens.name: size-tile-hero
tokens.usage: First session tile on the home screen.

tokens.name: size-tile-half
tokens.usage: Second and third session tiles, awrad and favourites tiles.

tokens.name: size-switch-w
tokens.usage: Switch track width.

tokens.name: size-switch-h
tokens.usage: Switch track height.

tokens.name: size-switch-thumb
tokens.usage: Switch thumb (on). Off thumb is 20.

tokens.name: size-bar-sm
tokens.usage: Progress track thickness, thin.

tokens.name: size-bar-md
tokens.usage: Progress track thickness, default.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Streak dot diameter.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Normal flow.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Floating navigation bar.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Alert dialogs above everything.
